## Why Software Engineers Need an ATS Resume Builder

In the tech industry, applicant tracking systems are programmed to look for very specific languages, frameworks, and methodologies. A single missing keyword like 'React.js' instead of 'React' can get your resume instantly archived. Apply4Works solves this by analyzing the exact JD and injecting the precise technical terminology required.
